setupAi.lead: Choose which AI powers your main assistant and paste a key or subscription token. Junior agents can get their own access later.

fail.timeout: The provider did not answer in time. Try again.
fail.unavailable: This way of connecting is not available on the server right now.
fail.format: The key has the wrong format.
